data_policy.content_storage: factual game discovery metadata and short assistant-generated Chinese summaries
data_policy.rights_note: Source images remain owned by their respective rights holders. Downloading and public visibility do not establish a redistribution license. No full descriptions, videos, game code or other game assets stored.

scope.sampling_rule: Up to the first 10 games in the visible homepage 热门免费游戏 numbered list; the rendered list explicitly contains only 5, all retained. Inspect the first 5 linked details. No filler games added.

source_extensions.detail_navigation_note: Five unique linked details inspected after the scheduled start; one Level Devil revisit solely corrected the thumbnail selector. No gameplay inputs, voting, authentication, or hidden APIs used. Source metadata is from rendered visible UI; nonvisible script contents are excluded.

scope.section_definition_raw: 根据实时游玩热度统计，这些是 Poki 上目前最热门的 5 大当红游戏 。
scope.position_semantics: Explicit numbered position in the homepage 热门免费游戏 list; source-claimed real-time play popularity without a disclosed formula. Not a global independently verified rank and not interchangeable with detail-page popularity rank.

limitations: Not a complete catalog or independently verified heat score.
Homepage numbered positions and detail popularity ranks disagree; preserved separately.
Displayed likes/dislikes are rounded; votes are not plays, unique users, or concurrency.
Date labels retain month-level precision; no exact release date invented.
Changes between observations may reflect source display or cache differences. No growth or popularity velocity is inferred from this short interval.
Game frames may auto-load on detail visits; no gameplay inputs, voting, login, or hidden APIs used.
Online labels, where present, are source display lower bounds with unspecified population and observation window; not verified CCU.
Subway Surfers shows 404未找到结果; HTTP response status is not exposed.
Some supported cloud-browser thumbnail downloads failed; no historical image bytes are substituted as a fresh fetch.
